city-care.text: Welcome to Null District. Your afterlife is in safe hands.
city-care.speaker: care

city-courier.text: Sable owns the city. Die owing them money, and they put you straight back to work.
city-courier.speaker: courier

court-vesper.text: I helped build their soul network. The Ashen Court supplies the dead. Sable works them until nothing is left.
court-vesper.speaker: vesper

court-regent.text: You may spend their memories. Their souls remain mine.
court-regent.speaker: regent

harvest-care.text: Your service continues after death. Please remain at your assigned station.
harvest-care.speaker: care

harvest-courier.text: After the crash, Sable put me back to work. They said one last delivery would clear my debt.
harvest-courier.speaker: courier

receipt-courier.text: My name. Date of death. So I never made it out.
receipt-courier.speaker: courier

receipt-vesper.text: They brought your body back. Your soul is still under contract. Just like mine.
receipt-vesper.speaker: vesper

vesper-plan.text: I tried to shut the network down. They killed me and trapped me inside it. Your name is on tonight's blacklist.
vesper-plan.speaker: vesper

vesper-courier.text: Blacklist? What happens to the people on it?
vesper-courier.speaker: courier

vesper-transfer.text: At midnight, Rainline sends their souls to the Court. We erase the list and sever the broadcast. No names, no transfer.
vesper-transfer.speaker: vesper

sword-vesper.text: Mournfang cuts the bindings that hold a soul. We need it to break the cathedral seals.
sword-vesper.speaker: vesper

sword-courier.text: You put this in my delivery. Why me?
sword-courier.speaker: courier

sword-choice.text: You can move through their checkpoints. I can't leave the wire. And you're the first courier who opened the package.
sword-choice.speaker: vesper

market-vesper.text: First, steal a rift key to get below the city. Break the cathedral seals, then recover the blacklist from the Kabuki broker.
market-vesper.speaker: vesper

train-vesper.text: The dead line carries sealed cargo to Rainline. Take the blacklist aboard. It will let us erase the names before the transfer.
train-vesper.speaker: vesper

train-care.text: Unauthorized passengers will be returned to processing. Thank you for your cooperation.
train-care.speaker: care

regent-warning.text: Break your contract, courier, and I will take the district in your place.
regent-warning.speaker: regent

regent-courier.text: You don't get them either. We're ending this.
regent-courier.speaker: courier

deploy-vesper.text: There's a surveillance terminal ahead. It can lead you to the rift key. I'll stay with you.
deploy-vesper.speaker: vesper

deploy-courier.text: Keep that channel open. We get everyone off that list.
deploy-courier.speaker: courier
